storage: internal SSD, APFS; not separately benchmarked
source: committed source exported with git archive; uncommitted UI edits excluded
limitations: Desktop applications and other development sessions remain running.
Generator, application and PostgreSQL share this laptop.
No reverse proxy or external network; Unix-socket and TCP loopback suites are reported separately.
PostgreSQL RSS includes shared mappings; summing it would overcount memory.
macOS ps percentage CPU is a marked lifetime-average diagnostic, not a per-request CPU cost.
host_sampler_scope: Main driver; recovered outbox also has separate per-worker CPU/RSS snapshots.
